goal: Consume AC-DEV-017 Candidate Execution Plans and produce deterministic, machine-readable Execution Admission Decisions for the approved Apex-owned definition projection path with task-scoped candidate selection and no runtime side effects.
scope: admission status evaluation for capability, ambiguity, policy, and human-gate outcomes
deterministic single-source candidate selection over compatible required capabilities
projection-aware capability requirements for bounded invocation
evidence and claim-state preservation in admission decisions
regression coverage constrained by AC-DEV-011 through AC-DEV-017
out_of_scope: permanent Goose, Freebuff, or other executor binding
moving scheduling, authority, verification, retry/rework, or semantic-success ownership outside Apex
runtime side effects or runtime adapter changes
architecture_constraints: Apex Control Plane owns admission policy, capability requirements, candidate selection, and decision projection
Apex Core owns runtime authority, verification, retry/rework policy, and semantic success
candidate selection is task-scoped and never permanent executor selection
equal-quality candidates remain ambiguous unless the supplied policy explicitly permits SOURCE_ID_ASC tie-breaking
NOT_PROVEN, NOT_SUPPORTED, UNKNOWN, PARTIAL, and PROVEN remain distinct
the native agent.definition_catalog capability is optional on the approved Apex-owned projection path and is never inferred from projection proof
bounded invocation requires proven projection integrity, attempt identity binding, fail-closed invocation, and result transport
no ECC installation and no dispatch or runtime side effects
acceptance_criteria: admission consumes a Candidate Execution Plan and emits a machine-readable Execution Admission Decision
blocked or ambiguous required capabilities fail closed
ADMITTED, BLOCKED_CAPABILITY, BLOCKED_AMBIGUITY, BLOCKED_POLICY, and HUMAN_GATE_REQUIRED are distinct
selection rationale, rejected candidates, evidence references, and claim states are preserved
native catalog NOT_PROVEN does not block the approved Apex-owned projection path, while any missing bounded-invocation capability blocks admission
identical Passport, Candidate Execution Plan, and policy inputs produce identical output
selection never transfers scheduling, authority, verification, retry, or semantic-success ownership
validation: admitted, capability-blocked, ambiguity-blocked, policy-denied, and human-gate tests
explicit tie-break policy and deterministic output tests
canonical Python tests and documentation validation
git diff --check and protected PR CI gate
